svg.title: Tray assignment
svg.desc: An empty bay needs an empty tray: which one?
svg.metadata: ["Bay B21 is empty and a customer is about to park. The job asks for 'any empty tray into bay B21': the tray is left blank for tray assignment to choose.", "The candidates are the three empty trays: tray T15, tray T20 and tray T24. The search starts at the bay and works outward.", "Each candidate's cost: travel time to the bay, plus 30 s for every tray crossed on the way. Tray T20 must pass tray T19, which holds a vehicle (illustrative values).", "Tray assignment fills the blank with the cheapest candidate: tray T15. No other tray has to move first.", "Execution: AGV-1 drives under tray T15, carries it into bay B21 and lowers it. The bay can switch to insert mode."]
